Venue: KuCoin
Headline: VerityAI (VERITY) Listing Campaign — 92,000 VERITY Giveaway

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
To celebrate VerityAI (VERITY) being listed on KuCoin, we will be launching a campaign to give away a 92,000 VERITY prize pool to qualified KuCoin users!
Trading Opening Time: 08:00 on November 26, 2026 (UTC)
Learn more about VerityAI (VERITY) here.
## Activity 1: Trade to Share a 75,000 VERITY Prize Pool with VERITY GemSlot Carnival
Campaign Period: From 08:00 on November 26, 2026, to 08:00 on December 3, 2026 (UTC)
Click "Join Now" to participate!
Once users successfully enroll in the campaign, they will automatically participate in the following two reward pools:
## (Pool 1) Lucky Draw — Trade VERITY to Share 15,000 VERITY!
All KuCoin users who complete at least $250 spot trading volume of VERITY during the campaign period will qualify for the Lucky Draw.
New users will receive 2× rewards.
Users who successfully invite at least 3 new users to register and complete KYC will also receive 2× rewards.
## (Pool 2) Trading Carnival — Trade VERITY, BTC and KCS to Share 60,000 VERITY!
Users must achieve a minimum spot trading volume of $600 in VERITY/USDT during the campaign period to qualify for rewards. Once eligible, users may continue trading VERITY/USDT, BTC/USDT and KCS/USDT to increase their share of the 60,000 VERITY prize pool.
VERITY trading volume will be counted as 2× toward the reward calculation.
Rewards will be allocated based on each user’s proportion of the total trading volume. The higher the adjusted trading volume, the greater the potential reward share, subject to a maximum cap of 1,000 VERITY per user.
KCS loyalty tiers and GemSlot loyal users can enjoy additional trading volume boosts!
## Activity 2: Learn & Earn — Learn About VerityAI (VERITY) and Share 17,000 VERITY
Campaign Period: From 08:00 on November 26, 2026, to 08:00 on December 10, 2026 (UTC)
Learning page coming soon.
During the campaign, users who complete the learning content, quiz, and designated tasks related to VerityAI (VERITY) will be eligible to share VERITY rewards on a first-come, first-served basis.
Activity 1 Notes
For the Lucky Draw Pool, rewards will be distributed to eligible users in accordance with the campaign rules and qualification requirements.
For the Lucky Draw Pool, a qualifying “new user” refers to a user who registers a new KuCoin account during the campaign period and completes full KYC verification. Users who successfully invite at least 3 qualifying new users will be eligible for the corresponding invitation bonus. The invitation bonus and the new user reward multiplier are cumulative and may be applied simultaneously if the eligibility criteria for both are satisfied.
Market maker accounts and institutional accounts are not eligible to participate in this campaign.
For the Trading Carnival Pool, the total trading volume will be calculated as follows:
Total Trading Volume Calculation: ((VERITY-USDT Trading Volume × 2) + Trading Volume of BTC-USDT and KCS-USDT) × Boost Multiplier
Reward Calculation: (Your Total Trading Volume ÷ Total Trading Volume of All Users) × 60,000 VERITY.
Terms and Conditions
Trading Volume = (buys + sells) x price.
Complete KYC verification to participate in the event. Accounts associated with the same identity will be considered a single participant. Sub-accounts are not eligible.
The trading activity on the platform will undergo rigorous inspection during the activity. For any malicious acts conducted during the period, including malicious transaction manipulations, illegal bulk registration of accounts, self-dealing, etc., the platform will cancel the qualification of the participants. KuCoin reserves all rights to exercise at its sole discretion to define if the transaction behavior is counted as cheating behavior and determine whether to cancel the participation qualification of a user. The final decision made by KuCoin is legal binding force on all participants who participated in the competition. Users hereby confirm that their registration and use of KuCoin are voluntary and are not forced, interfered with, or influenced by KuCoin in any way.
KuCoin reserves the right to disqualify users' reward eligibility if the account is involved in any dishonest behavior (e.g., wash trading, illegally bulk registered accounts, self-dealing, or market manipulation).
KuCoin reserves the final right to interpret these terms and conditions, including but not limited to the modification, change, or cancellation of the activity, without further notice.
Any disputes or inquiries regarding campaign results must be submitted within two (2) months following the end of the campaign. KuCoin reserves the right to decline requests for review submitted after this period, except where otherwise required by applicable law.
Where any discrepancy arises between the translated and original English versions, the English version shall prevail.
Investments in digital assets can be risky. Please carefully evaluate the risks of a product and your risk tolerance based on your own financial circumstances.
Apple is not a sponsor and is not involved in the activity in any manner.
